items.name: Kálvária
items.sourceRetrievedAs: Indexed municipal2023 FVS text; original PDF open timed out, no local original-byte hash
items.fact: The adopted2012 boundary is Kálvária sugárút/Londoni körút/Bakay Nándor utca/railway. The earlier Párizsi-körút/Kossuth-Lajos proposal is not the adopted area.
items.obstacle: Current named Bakay Nándor road way449464359 ends near[20.1214188,46.26162], roughly75m short of the main135 railway, way606753195. Complete local highway/railway extraction found private yard roads and abandoned/disused rail branches, but no unambiguous Bakay continuation to the main railway. Alternative historic rail branches make closure ambiguous. No connector or guessed choice was emitted.
items.possibleNextStep: Obtain the2012 naming-resolution map or a source-era local map that resolves which railway branch and the Bakay endpoint define the corner.

items.name: Móraváros
items.fact: Local-history article supplies an explicitly approximate four-side description: Petőfi Sándor sugárút/Moszkvai körút/Kálvária sugárút/Szeged–Békéscsaba railway.
items.obstacle: The current named Petőfi sugárút does not reach the railway; the nearest gap is over600m. Szabadkai út is a plausible omitted continuation and mentioned by other sources, but the literal four-side text is not sufficient to resolve the whole circuit. The much larger ten-side2008/2013 planning Móraváros unit must not be substituted as the same quarter.
items.possibleNextStep: A whole-quarter municipal/historical map or an explicit complete perimeter including the southern continuation.

items.name: Tarján housing estate (2019 description)
items.obstacle: The author specifies road sides, extends both sides of József Attila north of Budapesti körút, and mentions Murányi. Current named Murányi road segments stop short of the named Körtöltés line; Csillag-to-Retek also needs a verified square/junction transition. No guessed gap connector and no substitution of the distinct IVS circuit.
items.possibleNextStep: Trace the author’s source map or resolve the exact sides/junctions on a primary estate plan.

items.name: Klebelsberg-telep
items.sourceTitle: Szeged-Klebelsberg-telep története, edited by Újvári Edit,2007, ISBN978-963-06-2610-1
items.fact: Printedp9 describes a closed quarter between a western drainage channel, southern Holt-Tisza section, northern Körtöltés and eastern railway embankment.
items.obstacle: Positive source exists; western unnamed drainage channel and precise bank/embankment intersections have not yet been matched to literal linework. It is a remaining derivation task, not an assertion that data does not exist.
items.possibleNextStep: Use the source map/photo appendix and actual waterway/embankment ways to distinguish the western channel from other drainage features.
